label: SYNTHETIC_PPO_BENCHMARK
note: Evaluation uses the current EVAL_SCENARIOS in backend/ml/train_ppo.py.
measurement_note: All evaluation values are measured on synthetic cloned simulations. Scores are weighted delay plus residual-conflict penalty; lower is better. Regret is the chosen score minus the best measured eligible score at the same state. Mean score fields are descriptive and the CP-SAT mean covers only states where a CP-SAT candidate existed; compare regret instead.
